en.text:
Scoring a Kill from any source matching the elemental alignment of the weapon grants 20% increased damage for #e${6+#d} seconds.

Buff can activate while stowed.

Light Alignment: <arc/>Arc, <solar/>Solar, <void/>Void
Darkness Alignment: <stasis/>Stasis, <strand/>Strand

enhanced (
var d = 1
#e Buff duration is increased by 1 second.
